title: Joining Montana State University
text: Dr. Bazrafkan starts as Tenure-Track Assistant Professor of Precision Agriculture at MSU. The ABZN Lab opens in Bozeman and is recruiting its first graduate students.

title: Paper: YOLOv12 dry bean stand counting
text: Published in The Plant Phenome Journal: segmentation beats detection and thresholding for counting overlapping plants from low-cost RGB drone imagery (R² = 0.972), deployed as a web app for non-programmers.

title: Paper: automated center-pivot irrigation mapping
text: Out in Remote Sensing: YOLOv11 reaches 0.98 precision across Landsat 8, Sentinel-2 and NAIP imagery.

label: Earlier
title: Dry pea phenotyping studies published
text: Yield and protein estimation with multispectral data integration and ensemble learning, and dry pea maturity prediction with UAS sensor fusion.
